description: Every operand of a local feature declaration prohibits earlier stages from testing that feature (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ¬g? A
%emits
%stage second
%features f g
%conditions $.classes ∩ A ≠ ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A

```
